description: Figure 5, captioned “The average likes of headlines from different season groups,” is a bar chart with a horizontal axis labeled “Most similar group of posts,” displaying four distinct categories: (0,90), (90,180), (180,270), (270,360), and (360,450), which represent time intervals in days. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. Like #” and is scaled linearly from 400 to 600, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 50. Each bar is light blue and has an error bar extending above it, indicating variability. The bars are grouped and sorted in descending order by their height, with the tallest bar corresponding to the (360,450) group, reaching approximately 580 likes, and the shortest bar corresponding to the (0,90) group, reaching approximately 550 likes. The chart visually represents the average number of likes for headlines grouped by their similarity over different time intervals.
